name: Xuannv
description: Goddess of Strategy. All beings play as stones; each strike from wit alone.

skills.name: Outplay the Heavens
skills.description: Passive: Xuannv's normal attacks have two states; she starts each battle in the [Play as White] state. [Play as Black]: attacks the default target for 100% DMG, and each attack grants +20% ATK, stacking up to 3 times. [Play as White]: attacks change to strike the weakest enemy for 100% DMG. Active: Xuannv reads the board and makes her next move. If allies are equal to or outnumber enemies, she switches to the [Play as Black] state and gains +100% ATK SPD for 8s. If allies are outnumbered by enemies, she switches to the [Play as White] state and gains +100% ATK SPD for 8s.

upgrades.level2: On activation, also deals 500% ATK damage to all enemies.
upgrades.level3: While in the [Play as Black] state, gains 160% ATK SPD.
upgrades.level4: While in the [Play as White] state, gains an extra 50% normal-attack damage.

skills.name: Clumsy Move Controls
skills.description: Fires 3 stones at the nearest enemies (if there are fewer targets than stones, the same target is hit multiple times). Each hit deals 100% DMG and resolves an effect based on the energy gap between the two sides: if the target's current energy is lower than Xuannv's, she restores 50 energy; if the target's energy is equal to or higher than hers, the target loses 50 energy.

upgrades.level2: If the target has less energy, Xuannv restores 70 energy instead.
upgrades.level3: If the target has equal or more energy, the target loses 70 energy instead.
upgrades.level4: If the target has equal or more energy, the target loses 100 energy instead.

skills.name: Switch & Strike
skills.description: After combat starts, the frontmost ally is designated the White Stone and the backmost ally the Black Stone. The White Stone converts into a Black Stone once it enters the enemy backline; the Black Stone converts into a White Stone when an enemy is within 3 meters. Each unit can convert only once. Black Stone: deals 30% more damage. White Stone: takes 30% less damage.

upgrades.level3: When a unit converts from one state to the other, it gains a shield equal to 500% ATK.

skills.name: Step Into the Game
skills.description: When Xuannv is attacked, she summons a Taiji Circle for 3s that reduces all incoming damage by 50% and accumulates the reduced portion. When it expires, she fires Taiji projectiles at the nearest enemy dealing damage equal to the accumulated amount. 30s cooldown.

upgrades.level4: Reduces incoming damage by 80% instead of 50%.

relic.name: Void Feint
relic.description: Enhances Xuannv's states and can also trigger Step Into the Game. [Play as Black]: every attack deals extra damage equal to 200% ATK + 6% of the target's max HP (capped at 500% of Xuannv's ATK). [Play as White]: the first 3 normal attacks after entering the state deal extra damage equal to 200% ATK + 30% of the target's lost HP (capped at 500% of Xuannv's ATK).

upgrades.level2: When Step Into the Game is on cooldown and Xuannv takes damage, 50% chance to trigger Step Into the Game (this effect has a 30s cooldown).
upgrades.level4: [Play as Black]: extra damage becomes 300% ATK + 10% of the target's max HP (capped at 800% ATK). [Play as White]: the first 3 attacks deal 400% ATK + 60% of the target's lost HP (capped at 1000% ATK).

virtueSets.label: Desire
virtueSets.comment: 4pc ramps ATK passively after 15s - rewards long fights and boss content.

virtueSets.label: Wildness
virtueSets.comment: 4pc stacks +5% ATK every 5s up to 10 stacks - best sustained damage over a long fight.

virtueSets.label: Insight
virtueSets.comment: 4pc grants +30% CRIT Rate before first hit, amplifying burst in both stances.

coreMechanic.summary: Stance-dancing Physical carry. Her ultimate flips between a Black Stance (hits the default target, ramps +20% ATK per hit up to 3 stacks) and a White Stance (hits the weakest enemy, execute-flavored), and it picks the stance automatically from the ally-versus-enemy unit count. The Void Feint Relic is the real damage engine, adding per-hit %ATK + %target-HP riders that scale with the active stance. Step Into the Game converts incoming hits into a delayed Taiji reflect, while Clumsy Move Controls drains or refunds energy based on the energy gap.

strengths: Automatic stance switching adapts to the board on every ultimate - Black Stance ramps ATK for sustained single-target, White Stance pivots to the weakest enemy for cleanup
Void Feint Relic is the true damage engine: per-hit %ATK + %target-HP riders (up to 300% ATK + 10% max HP in Black, 400% ATK + 60% lost HP in White at Lv4) push her far above her base ATK
White Stance pairs %lost-HP damage with weakest-target selection, giving strong execute pressure to finish low units and bosses in their final phase
Step Into the Game turns incoming damage into a delayed Taiji reflect, rewarding her for being attacked and punishing multi-hit enemies
Clumsy Move Controls adds real energy disruption - draining up to 100 energy from higher-energy targets while refunding her own, delaying enemy ultimates
Switch & Strike buffs two designated allies (front White Stone, back Black Stone) with bonus damage / damage reduction plus a 500% ATK shield on conversion, so she supports while carrying
weaknesses: Stance is chosen by unit count, not player intent - in a losing fight with fewer allies she locks into White Stance even when the Black ramp would deal more
Black Stance ramp (max 3 stacks, +60% ATK) needs time on the same target; she is weak in the opening seconds before stacks and Relic riders build
Switch & Strike is heavily positioning-dependent - the front/back designations require intentional team construction and cannot be blind-slotted
Step Into the Game can be skipped by a single hard one-shot before the 3s Taiji Formation resolves
All damage is Physical, so enemy Armor and physical damage reduction hit her full kit; she has no magic or true component to bypass it
Energy drain and reflect value scale with fight length; in very short fights she underdelivers versus pure burst carries
